author: Jan Schenkel
html:
Truly inspiring article, Gerrit – rounding off an excellent series on how to go beyond the standard JavaFX controls.
Perusing the source on github, there’s just one thing about ResizeHelper that left me pondering: it currently adds the ResizeListener instance ‘deeply’ by iterating over the child nodes, to prevent that nodes near the edge of the scene interfere with the resize magic.
Could the same effect not be accomplished by means of a single EventFilter at the scene level instead ? That approach would be a little more ‘lightweight’ in terms of the number of event handlers called. This seemed to work fine in a test app, buut maybe I’m overlooking something – and in that case I would love to know what 😉
Cheers, Jan.

author: Gerrit Grunwald
html:
Hi Jan,
Well to be honest that might be true, I just found that solution in my collection of useful methods and used it without further thinking about it. So my suggestion would be, just create a branch from JdkButler and replace my solution with yours…then we both will know if it works as expected 🙂
What do you think…?
